businessModel: Free browser; Genspark cloud agents (Super Agent) sold via credit-based subscriptions
paidNote: Cloud agent features use Genspark credits; paid tiers exist (prices not confirmed, Plus ~$19.99-24.99/mo reported in an older review)
summary: Chromium browser from the Genspark AI workspace company: built-in ad blocker, Super Agent/Autopilot for tasks, an MCP store and optional on-device open-weight models. Free to install; cloud agents use credits.
bestFor: People who want a built-in ad blocker plus agents
notFor: People who want a transparent open-source browser

pros.title: Built-in ad blocker
pros.detail: Ads blocked by default after install, no extension needed (vendor-described).

pros.title: Local models option
pros.detail: Genspark says users can run open-weight models on-device; claimed catalog of 169 models.

pros.title: Agent tooling
pros.detail: Super Agent, Autopilot and an MCP store with 700+ app connections (vendor claim).

pros.title: Free to install
pros.detail: No fee for the browser; credits only for cloud agents.

cons.title: Little independent testing
cons.detail: Most coverage is promotional or aggregator write-ups.

cons.title: Credit-based agents
cons.detail: Super Agent and research use credits; prices unclear.

cons.title: Desktop only
cons.detail: macOS 15+ and Windows; mobile and Linux browsers not offered.

cons.title: Opaque pricing and policies
cons.detail: Plan details need sign-in; privacy policy not reviewed.
